items.title: U.S. economy slowed to 1.5% growth rate in Q2; June core inflation at 3.3%
items.summary: While the GDP number was below expectations, the miss appeared to come from a decline in federal government spending and inventories.

items.title: Singapore tightens monetary policy in surprise move as rising oil prices rekindle inflation risk
items.summary: Unlike most central banks, the MAS manages medium-term price stability by managing the Singapore dollar exchange rate against a trade-weighted basket of currencies.

items.title: Trump's new global tariff draws rebukes from trade partners over forced labor justification
items.summary: U.S. trading partners have rejected the forced labor rationale behind Trump's new global tariffs, while most signaled plans to keep negotiating.

items.title: Import prices post surprise gain as costs of goods from China hit highest since 2008
items.summary: Import prices were up 0.3% for the month, as a drop in energy was more than offset by increases elsewhere.

items.title: Fed Governor Cook says she's 'prepared to act' on rate hike to address inflation
items.summary: Cook was part of a 9-3 majority that voted last week to keep the central bank's benchmark borrowing rate in a range between 3.5%-3.75%.

items.title: As Warsh and the Fed contemplate fewer meetings, markets brace for potential volatility ahead
items.summary: Since taking office in May, Warsh has implemented several measures that reverse decades of Fed culture.

items.title: Bank of America spends $250 million a year on GLP-1 drugs for its employees, CEO says
items.summary: Employers have grappled with soaring demand for GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic and Wegovy, which can cost thousands of dollars per patient annually.

items.title: Situational Awareness hedge fund meltdown was a warning shot for leveraged markets, BofA CEO says
items.summary: Bank of America was among the prime brokers for the hedge fund, which is run by Leopold Aschenbrenner.

items.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
items.summary: As part of a planned Texas data center, Amazon is investing in an on-site power plant that could reportedly become the largest source of climate pollution in the United States.
